name: PixelCraft
description: PixelCraft is a free, privacy-focused online photo editor. Upscale, resize, compress, filter, rotate, watermark, and convert your photos 100% locally in your browser.
browserRequirements: Requires HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript support
featureList: Format Converter (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, TIFF, SVG, GIF, BMP)
Aesthetic Filters (Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Blur, Sepia)
